rules.exemptions: Hospital, skilled nursing or health facility; non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility (per D014)
rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: A Boston landlord ending a tenancy must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources with the notice to quit or non-renewal, and report it to the city. Violation does not halt the eviction.
rules.key_value: notice of rights with notice to quit; fine $300 per day after warning
